lines.text: Jesus says not one temple stone will be left on another, and the disciples ask when and what sign.
Jesus warns that many will come in His name, and when the disciples hear of wars, they should not be alarmed.
Nation will rise against nation, with earthquakes, famines and pestilences, and after all this the disciples will be brought before kings and governors.

wrong_details.wrong: after all this the disciples will be brought before kings and governors
wrong_details.true: before all this, they will seize and persecute the disciples

lines.text: Jesus tells the disciples not to plan their defense, since He will give them speech and wisdom, and soldiers will betray them.

wrong_details.true: parents and brothers and relatives and friends will betray them

lines.text: When armies surround Jerusalem, those in Judea should flee to the mountains, and Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles.
